## About
Calibey’s Oakhurst Auto Service Center is a repair and maintenance shop on Antilles Drive in Seminole. We cover the everyday work like oil changes, tune-ups and brakes, plus the harder jobs: check engine lights, suspension, A/C, electrical issues, and gas and diesel engine repair.
We use the same diagnostic equipment as the manufacturers, so we can find the real cause of a problem instead of swapping parts and hoping. A service advisor walks you through what we found, and you decide how to proceed.
Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating across 601 Google reviews. One visitor from out of state wrote that when his van wouldn't go into gear, Christian told him to have it towed in, found the problem and got him back on the road at a fair rate.

## Services
- Free code scan: We connect to your car, pull the stored codes and give you an easy to read printout before you commit to any work.
- Diagnostics and inspections: Thorough testing with manufacturer-level equipment to find the real fault.
- EVAP system leaks: Tracking down leaks in the EVAP system, which are hard to spot because fuel vapor is invisible.
- Oil change and tune-up: Routine maintenance to keep your car running well.
- Brakes: Brake work to keep you stopping safely.
- Shocks: Diagnosis and repairs when rough roads feel rougher or the car sways in turns.
- A/C repair: Getting your air conditioning working again.
- Gas and diesel engine repair: Engine work on gas and diesel vehicles.
- Exhaust service: Inspection and service of your exhaust system.
- Tires and batteries: Tire repair, new tires and batteries.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday. If your car acts up after we close, you can use our after-hours drop-off.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Fill out a key drop envelope or text us your concerns, seal your keys inside and leave it in our drop box. We'll reach out if we need more information and let you know when the car is ready.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can schedule online or by phone. Tell us what you're noticing with the car so we can give you useful advice from the start.

Q: Will you check with me before doing the work?
A: Yes. A service advisor will go over the findings and recommendations with you, or you can approve work right in your digital inspection report.
